Rescue parses fail: (1) coordination with 'helped' inside the relative clause '(that) we helped the CEOs remove their masks' is impossible because the copula 'were' and the first two list items intervene, closing that clause; (2) coordination with 'were' would make 'Some of the ways ... asked the CEOs' the reading, which is semantically incoherent and leaves the two infinitives as an unconjoined asyndetic list.
